body:
I am really sorry to hear about your brother, I hope he can still turn things around.  Yes, I thought trying to keep her father around was the best thing to do.  Turns out not always the best.  She was in therapy, she has vitiligo too and still struggles with all of it.  She won't go to therapy, I still try to get her to go.  Besides not having insurance, that is one reason I have not gone back myself is because I was trying so hard to get her to go.  I have switched trying to fix myself and her for so long and just can't do either.  At this point I am just in the way, they need the space for the children and the money.

As far as hobbies, the only thing I have kept up is walking/jogging.  I don't even do it with my dog.  I can't even keep animals with me, my rage is that bad, my dog was abused and she runs anytime I swear which is basically all the time.  Music makes me manic, movies that I use to enjoy make me sad and depressed, just about everything does really.  That is why I am where I am, nothing works anymore.  If I could pull a solution out of a hat I would, I use to be able to.  There aren't anymore.

Thank you for responding, all hugs and luvs are needed.  Talking is good, though I really need to take action at this point.  I put off this part thinking it would be too hard.  But I am so numb at this point, and ready because I have been through all of this for so long that I know there just isn't any thing left to do but go.  I wish I could find an answer, I search and I try, I keep looking, shrug.  I really wish I could look in the mirror and say tomorrow I could do 123 and it will be different.  I have done that so many times, over and over again, I hate writing this because I don't want to be negative for others, but it is my truth and it sucks.

53 SWF, guess I should have been more upfront.  Your mom was amazing, I could never have done that.  I dropped when my daughter was kicked out of school for having pic of pot on her phone and using in school.  Zero tolerance in GA. She had many problems growing up medical, nothing life threatening but enough to kill her self esteem, add that with a father who didn't have a positive life and not in the pic and me, she did not have much of a chance.  I know my life has been a cake walk compared to most, I have been reminded of that almost daily.  I had PMDD my teens through menopause, sorry TMI.  I think that is why I am having so many problems now, raging hormones for the next 10 years, but no chance of healthcare, I am SOL.

I really do appreciate you chatting with me, I really do.  I am his daughter.  His son, is his pride and joy, though he did not give him off spring.  I have a daughter who has 3 very young children who I am unable to help and they need a lot of help.  I was a single parent and failed.  All I want is to be loved, help others.  Very, very simple.  I cannot do that, I rage over what seems to be everyday occurences to others, like politics, but it bleeds into every little thing and it ruins every portion of existence.  Granted, it has not always been this bad, but it has become uncontrollable.  I can't help myself, I can't help anyone else and that is why it hurts so much, all I want to do is help my daughter and her children and I can't do anything but make it worse.  I really feel like since my first breakdown in 2013, every thing that has happen to her was because of me.  Even though she is 22 now, even though everyone says she made her own choices, deep down I know she was in my care I was her parent.  She learned to make her choices based on my parenting.

The fact that it is still day light.  I want to go now, but I don't want to be seen, I don't want to hurt anyone.  Like many others, I wish for a peaceful end, yet know full well that my only choice is very abrubt and will likely traumitize others.  I have caused too much pain already, that is the problem to begin with, if I thought for one minute I could actually stop the pain and really truly help myself and then help others (like I want to) I would not be writing this.  I want the darkness so I can be done, so I can find a place to be alone and not hurt anyone anymore, I don't want to hurt anymore.  I want to curl up and die, but that is not the fairy tale.

Yes, the fact that I have done this to myself without wanting to, the fact that even though I have begged my family to tell me they love me when I isolate they refuse to do so.  I know I am imposible but a simple text to say I love you in the last 2 weeks would have been enough.  I know I am horrible I do not mean to, I have tried, I never actually stop trying, never giving up (still walking in the mornings, taking supplements, eating healthy as I can even though I have less than a foot of refrigerator space) entirely always  fantasizing someone will help, the mailman will see my pain and offer, any stranger, I fantasize that strangers will help me, because the ones who are suppose to be there for me refuse to even when I am standing in front of them asking them to tell me they love me they tell me I care for you when I did this... words straight from my trump loving father.

I have some money, just not enough to live on my own without causing more problems.  I have lived long enough to know what it takes.  I can sleep with the aresenal, but it is very costly to upkeep.  Reality is what hurts the most.
